name: Cathay Pacific student fares (AUSTUDENT)
summary: Up to 10% off Cathay Pacific fares from Australia plus extra checked baggage for students using promo code AUSTUDENT.
key: Enjoy up to 10% off Economy, Premium Economy and Business class fares.
who: Anyone with valid proof of student status. No age limit is stated.
how: Apply the promotion code AUSTUDENT to your flight.
Show valid proof of student identity at check-in.
catches: Offer ends 1 December 2026, for departures 31 March 2026 to 31 October 2027.
Applies to selected fare classes only.
Without proof of student status at check-in you must buy a new non-student fare.
